experiments.title: Independent External Facility Generalization Gate
experiments.hypothesis: Perception F1 and tracking IDF1 maintain >= 85% without re-tuning when evaluated on a distinct, unseen physical warehouse facility with different camera layout and lighting.
experiments.dataset_requirement: Physically distinct facility (Facility E) with new capture sessions and independent annotations

experiments.title: Prospective Physical Intervention Backfire Study
experiments.hypothesis: Physical interventions across diverse operational zones exhibit secondary risk redistribution quantifiable via DiD with valid parallel trends (p >= 0.05).
experiments.dataset_requirement: Prospective real-world intervention capture with before, during, after, and control zones

experiments.title: Out-of-Sample Uncertainty Validation Across Unseen Cameras
experiments.hypothesis: Model H localized pitch compensation achieves >= 95.0% nominal OOS coverage on previously uncalibrated camera viewports without exceeding 0.40m interval width.
experiments.dataset_requirement: Independent camera viewport streams within nominal distance

experiments.title: Wide-Baseline Multi-Camera Re-Identification Robustness
experiments.hypothesis: Under non-overlapping wide-baseline camera handoffs, identity ambiguity engine enforces UNKNOWN without producing unsafe forced track swaps.

experiments.title: Real Continuous Long-Duration Endurance Validation
experiments.hypothesis: Continuous physical video inference exhibits zero unbounded memory growth, zero latency drift (>500ms), and zero track drift over multi-hour runs.

experiments.title: Distribution Shift Safe Refusal Robustness Battery
